title: Gill® GC-012 Battery Charger, 12V – Lightweight Battery Charger
description: Gill® GC-012 12VDC charger is a light-weight, fully automatic 3-stage charger that can be left on the battery for long periods of time. High strength aluminum case LED status shows power on, charging and full charging Circuit protection against reverse polarity and short circuits Charge control that is a modified constant current charge to a constant finishing voltage, then to a float standby Power cord length 6 feet and 4 foot Charge cord with ring terminals included
